tweets.title: A group of friends at a friend's engagement were discussing how the army of Instagram influencers actually worked as the media during the recent protest in Delhi. How unbiased they were and how they showed every detail without bias in this dictatorship. Notice two things : - They are consuming every piece of news through Instagram, without checking if it is true or not. - Stories spoken softly, with emotional acting and trending emotional sounds have a deep impact on the larger audience. They are sick of anchors hosting 10-person debates and people screaming with their lungs out in newsrooms. tweets.title: The more I understand mountain logistics and high-altitude warfare, the more I appreciate what the Indian Army accomplished. If push comes to shove, the Indian Army can undoubtedly undertake such missions even today. In many ways, it would be comparatively easier, thanks to far better surveillance, precision weapons, aviation assets, communications, and logistics.
